answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 7337 Country: India Title: I have been viewing porn or photos of naked women for several years. This crime by me is always in my mind and i want to seek forgiveness from God. My question is - What is mentioned in books related to this issue and what can i do to be forgiven by God. Question: Salam ali kum. I have been viewing porn or photos of naked women for several years. This crime by me is always in my mind and i want to seek forgiveness from God. My question is - What is mentioned in books related to this issue and what can i do to be forgiven by God. Answer ID: 7337 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1110/964=L/1429) First, you must determine not to view photos of naked women and pornographic sites and seek forgiveness sincerely from Allah. For this, you should perform two rakah salah of repentance , and thereafter seek forgiveness from Allah repenting from what you have done, it is hoped fully that Allah will forgive your sins. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
